label: August 10–16, 2026
intro: Mother's Day public holiday midweek gives you a free day together, then Character Fest Thailand 2 kicks off Friday — Thor's kind of pop-culture weekend.

activities.title: Character Fest Thailand 2 — Opening Days
activities.date: Friday–Sunday August 14–16 (festival continues through Sunday Aug 17)
activities.location: CentralWorld, Level 1 – Beacon Zone, Central Court & Eden Zone (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.why: Pop culture characters, interactive booths, exclusive merch — this is opening energy weekend with the most performances. If Thor loves any characters (Marvel heroes, anyone?), this is the place to discover them.
activities.tip: Friday afternoon has shorter queues than Saturday. Keep Sunday as backup if Saturday gets too crowded.

activities.title: Thai Mother's Day — Royal Bangkok & Family Time
activities.location: Grand Palace / Chao Phraya riverfront / Sanam Luang
activities.price: Grand Palace entry ~500 THB adults / free for children under 120 cm
activities.why: Public holiday = free day together. The city decorates beautifully with jasmine garlands for Queen Sirikit's birthday. A gentle cultural morning Thor will remember.
activities.tip: Go early (8–10 AM) before crowds build. Many parks and riverfront areas host free family events on Mother's Day.

activities.title: NSM 'Brain Inside Out' — FINAL DAYS
activities.location: National Science Museum (NSM), Technopolis, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani
activities.why: Absolute last chance — this hands-on brain science exhibition closes August 13. If you missed it last week, Tuesday or Wednesday are your final shots.
activities.tip: Tuesday morning is the quietest. Do not wait — it closes permanently Wednesday the 13th.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Sessions
activities.time: 12:00–9:00 PM (call ahead for Mother's Day Aug 12 holiday hours)
activities.why: Cool air-conditioned skating while school is still on break. Weekday sessions are quieter — more ice space for Thor to practise.
activities.tip: The Mother's Day holiday (Aug 12) may draw bigger crowds. Monday or Tuesday are your best bets for a quiet session.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Sessions
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Shopping Mall (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.price: ~150–200 THB per session incl. skate rental
activities.why: After Character Fest buzz at CentralWorld, cool down with rollerblading. Two activities, two different vibes — perfect split weekend.
activities.tip: Character Fest Saturday → Roller Dome Sunday is an easy winning combination.
